Come fly with us

Quiet. Weightless. Unforgettable.

No engine. No noise. Just a sailplane, rising air, and a view of the Finger Lakes few people ever get to see.

FLSC is a cooperative club where experienced pilots share their time, knowledge, and love of flight. Take a scenic ride, begin training, or join a community built around helping each other fly.

Choose your adventure

A front-row seat
to the horizon.

Rides fly most weekends from May through October, weather and aircraft availability permitting. Reservations are recommended.

Training that lifts you

Don’t just ride.
Learn to fly.

Start learning at any age; students can solo a glider at 14. Club instructors volunteer their time, so members pay for aircraft operations—not instruction.

Explore the training path →
01

Meet the club

Visit a flying day, see operations up close, and talk with pilots and instructors.

02

Join the team

Learn launch operations, help on the field, and become part of a cooperative crew.

03

Take the controls

Train with volunteer FAA-certificated instructors toward solo and your pilot certificate.

More than a flight school

A club works because
everyone pitches in.

Members record operations, launch sailplanes, care for equipment and facilities, and serve as tow pilots or instructors. That shared effort keeps soaring accessible—and makes every flying day feel like a team accomplishment.
